Input images:

This is just a finished image, not a device mockup, web screenshot or UI layout.

Harmonious color balance; not the overwhelmingly neon green from old gameplay; crisp deliberate pixel clusters, slightly chunky retro game pixels and clean dark contours. Charming, professionally art-directed 2D pixel illustration, not smooth handpainting, not 3D, not photorealism.
Text (verbatim): "MOSSLUME" — exactly M O S S L U M E. One substantial golden wooden pixel-wordmark with dark clean shadow/outline, subtle moss/leaf accents, matching Image 2 identity but simpler enough for a clear cover. NO other text.

Not a title screen with menu controls. Single finished beautiful promotional card ready to post.
